name: Adam

team.summary: The team is led by founder Zach from YC W25, building Adam as an open-source AI CAD platform.

evidence.quote: Hey HN! I'm Zach from Adam ( https://adam.new/ ). We're building AI agents for mechanical CAD software.
YC batch: W25

product.summary: CADAM is an open-source Text to CAD platform that generates parametric 3D models and textured meshes from natural language and images using OpenSCAD compiled to WebAssembly.

evidence.quote: We’re building CADAM, an open source Text to CAD platform.
Outputs OpenSCAD code with automatically extracted parameters that surface as interactive sliders for instant dimension tweaking
Runs fully in-browser by compiling OpenSCAD to WebAssembly

size_hint.summary: Targeting mechanical design and 3D modeling users who utilize CAD software for prototyping and manufacturing parts.

evidence.quote: AI will be the primary medium for creating mechanical designs just like it is in software today.

competitors.summary: Commenters noted alternatives in the text-to-CAD and AI design space including TinkerCAD, CADEM, tooltrace.ai, quidities.com, and ModelRift.

evidence.quote: Think of it like AI TinkerCAD.
FYI there is already a product with a very similar name, CADEM.
evidence.author: zardo

evidence.quote: Check out modelrift.com for another alternative
evidence.author: jetter

why_now.summary: Advancements in LLM code generation and in-browser WebAssembly compilation enable real-time text-to-CAD rendering and interactive parameter tweaking.

evidence.quote: Runs fully in-browser by compiling OpenSCAD to WebAssembly (in a Web Worker, so the UI never blocks) and rendering with Three.js

risks.risk: LLMs lack reliable spatial reasoning and mechanical awareness, leading to inaccurate models.

evidence.quote: LLMs are still weak at spatial reasoning, but it gets better.
the resulting models may be visually close to what is required, but they are not technically accurate.

risks.risk: Scepticism from professional engineers regarding the utility of OpenSCAD and text-based generation for real manufacturing workflows.

evidence.quote: Even if all I need is a simple little bracket or something, I can model that and know it's right much quicker than I can ask the AI
OpenSCAD is a joke, and if you seriously try to tell me that 'the best paradigm for CAD generation is to generate CAD as code', I cannot take you seriously.

founder_depth.why: Founder is technical and backed by YC W25 with a working open-source shipping product, though deep domain background details are light in the text.

evidence.quote: Hey HN! I'm Zach from Adam ( https://adam.new/ ). We're building AI agents for mechanical CAD software.
YC batch: W25

shipping_evidence.why: Extensive public code, GitHub repository with over 5,000 stars, live demo links, and local runnable code.

evidence.quote: Try it: https://adam.new/cadam/
Repository: Adam-CAD/CADAM
Stars: 5134

demand_signal.why: High Hacker News engagement with 215 points and 97 comments, plus thousands of GitHub stars and users reporting successful prints.

evidence.quote: Points: 215  Comments: 97
Saw this and after 5 minutes of prompting I have four custom bumpers printing. This is a great product.

defensibility.why: Open-source codebase wrapping OpenSCAD via Vercel AI SDK and WebAssembly, leading to questions from users regarding moats and ease of replication.

evidence.quote: Model-agnostic via the Vercel AI SDK: Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), and OpenAI/others through OpenRouter
How do you differentiate from other open source AI CAD solutions? I’ve also had a good experience with Claude Code and CadQuery... I.e. what’s your moat?

analysis.thesis_fit_reason: CADAM is an AI-powered developer and engineering tool used by technical designers to generate mechanical CAD code, offered as open-source software.
analysis.case_summary: Strong public shipping trail and developer engagement, offset by deep skepticism from professional engineers regarding spatial reasoning and text-to-code CAD paradigms.
would_change_my_mind: Demonstrable adoption by professional mechanical engineers for production-grade manufacturing assemblies.
Transition to geometry kernels or constraint-driven modeling like CadQuery/build123d solving spatial inaccuracies.
Evidence of sustainable commercial revenue or enterprise adoption of the paid adam.new product.
data_gaps: Details on revenue, team size, and commercial traction of the adam.new product.
Comprehensive benchmarks comparing OpenSCAD output accuracy against traditional CAD tools.
